_comment_: Minimal gateway config. Points at the public AXIS registry and a local upstream you want to protect.
_comment_sharedSecret_: Shared secret the gateway sends as X-AXIS-Gateway-Secret so upstream can trust the X-AXIS-* identity headers. Rotate in production.
_comment_passthrough_: If true, paths not listed below are forwarded unmodified. Default false: strict deny.

routes._comment_: Anyone verified at domain-tier or higher can POST articles, provided their delegation chain grants write:articles.
Reading articles: any verified agent is fine. No scope check.
Admin surface: KYB-individual minimum plus an admin scope.
Public: no auth required. Token is ignored if present.
